evidence.title: GitHub - Nutlope/hallmark: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.

name: Hallmark
summary: Design skill for AI coding agents that builds, audits and redesigns UI without the AI-generated look.
description: One SKILL.md for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, installed with npx skills add or copied into the agent's skills folder. A build mode picks a macrostructure and one of twenty-one themes, runs fifty-seven slop-test gates plus a pre-emit self-critique, and refuses template defaults; audit scores existing code, redesign rebuilds the structure while keeping copy and brand, and study extracts macrostructure, type pairing and colour anchor from a URL or screenshot, optionally emitting a design.md for handoff.
contains: study mode can emit a design.md for handoff
